[[File:DarkWolf-LoNH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] beast master and his dark wolf]]
'''Beastmasters''', also known as '''beast masters''', '''beast handlers''' or '''creature handlers''', were masters who handled animals and often worked in [[Circus/Legends|circuses]] and arenas. They were also animal collectors for beautiful, dangerous and exotic animals from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] such as the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]], [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], [[Bursa/Legends|bursa]], and [[Reek/Legends|reek]]. Rare creatures collected by beast masters included the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]], the [[Raquor'daan/Legends|raquor'daan]], and the [[Ixzinian rock ram]]. Creatures such as the wampa, gundark, [[hanadak]], [[arqet]], and the rancor were trained for the arena by beast masters.

[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] killed a beast master's [[borhek]] in a [[Pit Fight Arena|beast pit]] on [[Outland Transit Station]].<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
